scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m cofield.cli seed
scripts.gen:api: cd apps/api && uv run python ../../scripts/export_openapi.py && cd ../web && pnpm gen:api
scripts.check:contract: pnpm gen:api && git diff --exit-code artifacts/openapi.json apps/web/lib/api-types.ts
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:domain-purity && pnpm lint:vocabulary && pnpm check:contract
